description:
Use this when the user wants platforms side by side: "which platform got the most views for this clip",
        "TikTok vs Shorts vs Reels this month", "where do my clips perform". clip_id: that clip everywhere it was posted; empty =
        all posts of the last `days` (default 30, up to 90). Per platform: number of posts, average views after 1 hour,
        24 hours and 7 days, the newest likes, comments, shares and saves the platform sent (null when it sends none),
        and what that platform counts as a view. Platforms count views differently: compare each against its own
        history and do not add them up.
        Not for: individual posts (get_post_stats), the weekly recap (weekly_report) or posting hours
        (best_time_to_post). Free and read only; covers posts RipClip published.
name: compare_platforms
title: Compare platforms
